chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassha, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'For every believer there is a Protector (Hafiz) and an Informer (Sa'ib).' I said: 'And what is the Protector, and what is the Informer, O Abu Ja'far?' He said: 'The Protector is from Allah, Blessed and High, a protector from Wilayah by which the believer is protected by which the believer is protected wherever he is. And as for the Informer, it is the good news of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) which Allah, Blessed and High, gives to the believer wherever he is and in whatever situation he is in.'

key_terms.سَائِبٌ: Informer or Announcer of good news

ai.seo_question: What are the Hafiz and Sa'ib for every believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (as), the concept of divine guardianship is personalized, defining the 'Hafiz' as a spiritual protector linked to Wilayah who safeguards the believer's faith, while the 'Sa'ib' serves as a bearer of glad tidings from the Prophet. This highlights the Shia belief in the continuous, active spiritual support granted to believers through the chain of Imams and Prophetic legacy, ensuring their preservation and joy regardless of their physical location. The terminology reflects the interplay between divine protection and the communicative role of the Ahl al-Bayt in sustaining the believer's hope.
